policy.purpose: Track official curriculum documents and the evidence used to reconcile the SchoolPadi curriculum export.
policy.verificationRule: A discovered or source-compared document does not make an indicator verified. Only an individually reviewed indicator with exact wording, content-standard context, exemplar evidence, publisher, edition, page and official URL may be added to curriculum-verification.json.
policy.checksumRule: Capture a SHA-256 checksum from the downloaded source PDF before a document is treated as an archived evidence copy.
policy.canonicalDataRule: Do not edit generated api/_curriculum_index.js by hand. Preserve the database export and record proposed corrections separately until reviewed.
